Context: 4. Commuted Leave

## 4. Commuted Leave  
1. Commuted leave not exceeding half the amount of half pay leave due can be taken on medical certificate. - Rule 30 (1).
2. Commuted leave can be taken without medical certificate-
3. (a) up to a maximum of 90 days in the entire service if utilized for an approved course of study certified to be in public interest  
- Rule 30 (1-A).  
- (b) up to a maximum of '60 days by a female Government servant if it is in continuation of maternity leave. - Rule 43 (4).
